title: Luscious Briny Middle Eastern Lamb Kibbeh
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb and vine leaves, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe combines the flavors of lamb, spices, and vine leaves in a crispy kibbeh shell.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the vine leaves by rinsing and draining them.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, bulgur, onion, spices, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Lay a vine leaf flat and place a tablespoon of the lamb mixture in the center.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining vine leaves and lamb mixture.
Place the kibbeh in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the kibbeh and bake for 25 minutes.
Serve the kibbeh hot, garnished with lemon wedges and chopped parsley.
